address.zh: 高雄市橋頭區新興路 9 號
address.en: No. 9, Xinxing Rd., Qiaotou Dist., Kaohsiung City, Taiwan

headline.zh: 風味之間，找到你的心之所選。

intro.zh: 日常小酌到重要相聚，慢慢挑選喜歡的風味。選好酒款與數量送出後，我們會透過 LINE 與您確認價格、庫存與配送方式。這是詢價，正式訂購以我們確認後為準。

desc.zh: 來自陡峭坡地手工採收葡萄，帶皮自然發酵約15天，於小型橡木桶中熟成至少18個月。帶有漿果、草本植物、杜松子與紅醋栗的複合香調，並有細緻香料味、黑櫻桃及淡淡煙燻感。口感多汁優雅，單寧細緻內斂，結構平衡，屬中等酒體。
desc.en: Hand-picked from steep slopes, fermented on the skins for about 15 days and aged at least 18 months in small oak barrels. Layered notes of berries, herbs, juniper and redcurrant, with delicate spice, black cherry and a faint smokiness. Juicy and elegant, with fine restrained tannins, balanced structure and a medium body.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：黑皮諾｜酒精濃度：11.5%｜搭配：烤鮭魚、冷肉起司拼盤
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Pinot Noir | Alcohol: 11.5% | Pairing: grilled salmon, cold cuts and cheese platter

desc.zh: 陡峭坡地手工採收葡萄，自然酵母於500L橡木桶中發酵陳釀至少18個月，葡萄藤生長於貧瘠崎嶇土壤，風味集中。展現純淨礦物清新感，風格直接輕盈，入口帶成熟杏桃與白色花朵的細緻香氣，層次優雅富表現力。
desc.en: Hand-picked from steep slopes, fermented with wild yeast in 500 L oak barrels and aged at least 18 months. The vines grow in poor, rugged soils, concentrating the fruit. Pure, fresh minerality with a direct, light style — ripe apricot and white blossom on the palate, elegantly layered and expressive.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：12%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：烤鴨胸、蕈菇起司葉菜沙拉
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 12% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: seared duck breast, mushroom and cheese leaf salad

desc.zh:
陡峭坡地手工採收葡萄，於不鏽鋼桶自然發酵並以冷卻中止發酵鎖住天然甜分，隨後於細酒泥上陳釀5-6個月。散發成熟蟠桃與接骨木花細緻香氣，並帶摩澤爾經典板岩礦物氣息，口感絲絨般滑順，果酸與甜度平衡，酒精濃度僅8%，輕盈清爽且富層次。
✿2025年榮獲Falstaff雜誌93+高分評價✿
desc.en:
Hand-picked from steep slopes, naturally fermented in stainless steel and stopped by chilling to lock in the natural sweetness, then aged 5-6 months on the fine lees. Delicate aromas of ripe flat peach and elderflower with the classic Mosel slate minerality. Velvet-smooth, balanced between acidity and sweetness, just 8% alcohol — light, refreshing and layered.
✿Awarded 93+ by Falstaff magazine, 2025✿

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：8%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：清爽雪酪、輕盈戚風蛋糕
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 8% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: sorbet, light chiffon cake

desc.zh: 捕捉漢堡城市的清涼礦物味與清爽感，靈感來自年輕釀酒師Corvin Prigge。乾型雷司令充滿青蘋果香氣與黑醋栗葉香味，令人印象深刻，鵝卵石味與微苦酸度賦予清涼礦物質感，如微風吹過港口。
desc.en: Captures the cool minerality and freshness of Hamburg, inspired by young winemaker Corvin Prigge. A dry Riesling full of green apple and blackcurrant leaf, with pebble-like minerality and gently bitter acidity — like a breeze off the harbour.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：12%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：海鮮沙拉、雞肉料理
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 12% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: seafood salad, chicken dishes

desc.zh: 社交聚會與熱鬧對話的完美伴侶，帶著迷人甜美氣息，是與親朋好友共度悠閒夜晚的理想選擇。活潑雷司令以濃郁果香打動人心，散發柑橘、橙皮香氣，並帶一絲怡人殘留甜味，清新酸度為味蕾注入活力。
desc.en: The perfect companion for gatherings and lively conversation, with a charming touch of sweetness for an easy evening among friends. A lively Riesling with generous fruit — citrus and orange peel — a pleasant thread of residual sweetness and fresh acidity that lifts the palate.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：10.5%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：燒烤料理、清淡醬汁義大利麵
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 10.5% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: grilled dishes, pasta with light sauces

desc.zh: 踏入玫瑰園（Rosengärtchen），這款干型雷司令以清新的柑橘香氣迷住味蕾，在清爽的酸度與礦物風味之間取得完美平衡，入口時如氣泡般輕盈閃耀，口感如同俯瞰玫瑰葡萄園壯麗景色一般令人驚艷。
desc.en: Step into the rose garden (Rosengärtchen). This dry Riesling charms the palate with fresh citrus, perfectly balanced between bright acidity and minerality. It sparkles on entry — as striking as the view over the rose vineyard.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：11%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：越南米粉沙拉、抱子甘藍葡萄堅果沙拉
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 11% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: Vietnamese rice-noodle salad, Brussels sprout salad with grapes and nuts

desc.zh: 經典瓶裝發酵氣泡酒，以美妙宜人的氣泡和細膩的果香滿足味蕾，酸度與果味完美平衡，起泡以特別美味的方式在舌頭上滾動。
desc.en: A classic bottle-fermented sparkling wine with pleasing bubbles and delicate fruit. Acidity and fruit in perfect balance, the mousse rolling across the tongue in a particularly delicious way.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：12.5%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：小沙拉、鹹味小吃
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 12.5% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: small salads, savoury snacks

desc.zh: 經典瓶裝發酵氣泡酒，細膩氣泡與優雅而輕微的舌尖刺痛感令人印象深刻，微妙的奶油蛋捲味與細膩酸度相結合，賦予氣泡酒獨特風味。
desc.en: A classic bottle-fermented sparkling wine with fine bubbles and an elegant, gentle prickle on the tongue. Subtle brioche notes combine with delicate acidity to give it a character all its own.

taste.zh: 產區：德國摩澤爾｜葡萄品種：麗絲玲｜酒精濃度：12.5%｜適飲溫度：8-12°C｜搭配：薯條等鹹香小點
taste.en: Region: Mosel, Germany | Grape: Riesling | Alcohol: 12.5% | Serve at: 8-12°C | Pairing: fries and other savoury snacks

name.zh: 法國 - 2020 珍藏蝴蝶紅酒

desc.zh: 陳釀於法國橡木桶中長達12個月，磚紅色酒體，香氣濃郁而豐富，帶覆盆子、松露和焦糖味道，口感濃厚，有果醬、咖啡和巧克力風味，同時散發白花香氣，單寧柔順，回味悠長，複雜而開放，喝過後令人難忘。
desc.en: Aged 12 months in French oak. Brick-red in the glass with rich, generous aromas of raspberry, truffle and caramel. Full on the palate with jam, coffee and chocolate, lifted by white blossom. Supple tannins and a long finish — complex, open and memorable.

taste.zh: 產區：超級波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：梅洛、卡本內佛朗、卡本內蘇維濃｜酒精濃度：13.5%｜適飲溫度：16-18°C｜搭配：法式香煎牛排、烤小乳牛、各式乳酪
taste.en: Region: Super Bordeaux | Grapes: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon | Alcohol: 13.5% | Serve at: 16-18°C | Pairing: pan-seared steak, roast veal, assorted cheeses

name.zh: 法國 - 2020 頂級珍藏蝴蝶紅酒

desc.zh: 限量1200瓶，好年份才有生產。由58年的卡本內佛朗老藤所釀造，於400L法國橡木桶中陳釀30個月。深寶石紅色，帶朱紅色反光，香氣濃郁，讓人想起摩卡、李子和黑色水果，口感和諧柔和，帶卡本內佛朗特有的薄荷清新感和甜椒味，橡木桶陳釀增添咖啡與焦糖香氣，餘味悠長甜美，具較強陳年潛力。
desc.en: Limited to 1,200 bottles and made only in good vintages. From 58-year-old Cabernet Franc vines, aged 30 months in 400 L French oak. Deep gem red with crimson highlights. Intense aromas recalling mocha, plum and black fruit; harmonious and soft on the palate with the minty freshness and sweet pepper typical of Cabernet Franc. The oak adds coffee and caramel, with a long, sweet finish and real ageing potential.

taste.zh: 產區：超級波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：100%卡本內佛朗｜酒精濃度：14%｜適飲溫度：16-18°C｜搭配：法式香煎牛排、烤小乳牛、各式乳酪
taste.en: Region: Super Bordeaux | Grape: 100% Cabernet Franc | Alcohol: 14% | Serve at: 16-18°C | Pairing: pan-seared steak, roast veal, assorted cheeses

name.zh: 法國 -  2022 橡木桶特釀紅酒

desc.zh: 經過12個月的法國橡木桶陳釀，每年固定替換新橡木桶並使用不同烘烤程度以增加複雜性，陳年使其平衡度更佳。酒體飽滿、圓潤，熟透的紅色水果香氣伴隨輕盈胡椒味，使搭配的肉類菜餚和巧克力甜點口感更升華。
desc.en: Aged 12 months in French oak, with barrels rotated each year and different toast levels for added complexity; bottle age rounds it further. Full and round, with ripe red fruit and a light pepper note that lifts meat dishes and chocolate desserts alike.

taste.zh: 產區：AOC波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：梅洛、卡本內佛朗、卡本內蘇維濃、馬爾貝克｜酒精濃度：15%｜適飲溫度：16-18°C｜搭配：法式香煎牛排、烤小乳牛、各式乳酪
taste.en: Region: AOC Bordeaux | Grapes: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec | Alcohol: 15% | Serve at: 16-18°C | Pairing: pan-seared steak, roast veal, assorted cheeses

desc.zh: 我們的葡萄園多位於日照充足的丘陵地帶，葡萄熟成度高，展現出濃郁的果香與飽滿的酒體，並具備卓越的陳年潛力。釀造上，我們延續波爾多傳統工藝，細緻呈現紅葡萄酒的典雅風格。在酒液中，常可發現甘草與黑胡椒的香氣，與葡萄品種所帶出的紅色水果風味相得益彰，層次分明、韻味悠長。
desc.en: Grown on sun-drenched hillside vineyards ensuring optimal grape ripeness, full body, and excellent cellaring potential. Crafted using traditional Bordeaux methods to highlight elegance. Features licorice and black pepper aromatics harmonious with ripe red fruit flavors, delivering distinct layers and a lasting finish.

taste.zh: 產區：AOC波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：梅洛、卡本內佛朗、卡本內蘇維濃、馬爾貝克 (Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec)｜酒精濃度：14%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：肉類（煎 / 烤 / 燉）與各式乳酪
taste.en: Region: AOC Bordeaux | Grape: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec | Alcohol: 14% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: Seared, roasted, or braised meats, assorted cheeses

desc.zh: 葡萄經手工採收後先進行壓榨，外表呈淡檸檬黃色、明亮且高雅。濃郁的水果香氣，如蜜桃、檸檬和微微的花香，沉醉迷人。果味十足、酸甜平衡、口感清爽、餘味悠長。
desc.en: Hand-harvested grapes are gently pressed, producing a bright and elegant pale lemon wine. Offers inviting fruity aromas of nectarine, lemon, and subtle floral nuances. Fruit-forward with fine sweet-acid balance, delivering a crisp palate and long finish.

taste.zh: 產區：AOP波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：賽美濃、白蘇維濃 (Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc)｜酒精濃度：12.5%｜最佳品飲溫度：14-16度｜適合搭配：魚蝦海鮮以及家禽類菜餚（如法式奶油蘑菇雞）、甜點
taste.en: Region: AOP Bordeaux | Grape: Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc | Alcohol: 12.5% | Serving Temp: 14-16°C | Food Pairing: Seafood, poultry dishes, desserts

desc.zh: 波爾多聖馬凱爾法定產區（最古老的風土產區之一），細膩黏土與紅色礫石風土釀造出個性十足的葡萄酒。橡木桶中陳釀6個月，散發桃子、葡萄柚和礦物質及奶油堅果的香氣，入口圓潤而柔滑，優雅大方融合了新鮮柑橘水果，芳香複雜。
desc.en: From the Saint-Macaire appellation — one of Bordeaux's oldest terroirs — where fine clay and red gravel produce a wine of real character. Aged 6 months in oak, with peach, grapefruit, mineral and creamy nut aromas. Round and silky on entry, elegantly blending fresh citrus with complex aromatics.

taste.zh: 產區：AOP波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：白蘇維翁｜酒精濃度：12%｜適飲溫度：14-16°C｜搭配：魚蝦海鮮、家禽類菜餚（如法式奶油蘑菇雞）、甜點
taste.en: Region: AOP Bordeaux | Grape: Sauvignon Blanc | Alcohol: 12% | Serve at: 14-16°C | Pairing: fish and shellfish, poultry such as creamy mushroom chicken, desserts

name.zh: 法國 - 2022 Y'A DE LA JOIE 歡樂粉紅酒
name.en: France — 2022 Y'A DE LA JOIE Rosé

desc.zh: 使用最古老品種之一「神索」直接壓榨的粉紅葡萄酒，口感絲絨般柔和滑順，帶有櫻桃、草莓、覆盆子、李子、紅醋栗和石榴等紅色水果香氣，餘味精緻清新，散發迷人水果香氣。
desc.en: A rosé pressed directly from Cinsault, one of the oldest grape varieties. Velvet-soft and smooth, with cherry, strawberry, raspberry, plum, redcurrant and pomegranate. A refined, fresh finish and charming fruit aromas.

taste.zh: 產區：波爾多產區｜葡萄品種：梅洛、神索｜酒精濃度：13.5%｜適飲溫度：8-10°C｜搭配：開胃菜、海鮮卷、燒烤BBQ、夏季涼拌菜餚
taste.en: Region: Bordeaux | Grapes: Merlot, Cinsault | Alcohol: 13.5% | Serve at: 8-10°C | Pairing: starters, seafood rolls, BBQ, summer salads

desc.zh:
單桶精選當年最好的希拉，21年是精彩的一年，於法國橡木桶中陳釀兩年。外觀呈深暗寶石紅，鼻腔散發沙士、黑莓果醬、荊棘、柑橘李子、檀香木以及優雅烘焙香料的香氣。口感濃郁且富有層次，飽滿的黑李子和黑莓風味伴隨著甘草和茴香，是值得收藏的佳作。
✿Halliday Wine Companion 96分✿
desc.en:
A single-barrel selection of the year's best Shiraz — 2021 was a superb vintage — aged two years in French oak. Deep dark gem red, with sarsaparilla, blackberry jam, bramble, citrus plum, sandalwood and elegant baking spice on the nose. Rich and layered on the palate, full of black plum and blackberry with liquorice and anise. One to cellar.
✿Halliday Wine Companion 96 points✿

taste.zh: 巴羅莎谷 (Barossa Valley)｜葡萄品種：Shiraz (希拉)｜酒精濃度：14.4%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：頂級牛排、香草烤羊排、濃郁紅肉料理
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Shiraz | Alcohol: 14.4% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: Premium steak, herb-roasted lamb chops, rich red meat dishes

desc.zh:
香氣充滿乾燥紫羅蘭、黑加侖、胡椒粒與可可的氣息，還帶有榛果和甜香料。口感柔滑且圓潤，酒體飽滿，單寧絲滑如天鵝絨，尾韻帶有美味的巧克力和甜香料，餘味悠長。來自1881年種植的400株老藤葡萄，僅生產1,485瓶，承載著巴羅莎歷史。
✿2024 Halliday 92分、James Suckling 93分、The Real Review四星推薦；限量1,485瓶✿
desc.en:
Aromas of dried violet, blackcurrant, cracked pepper and cocoa, with hazelnut and sweet spice. Smooth and round, full-bodied, with velvet tannins and a long finish of chocolate and sweet spice. From 400 old vines planted in 1881 — only 1,485 bottles, a piece of Barossa history.
✿2024 Halliday 92, James Suckling 93, The Real Review 4 stars; 1,485 bottles✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷 (Barossa Valley)｜葡萄品種：Shiraz (希拉)｜酒精濃度：14.6%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：頂級牛排、精緻熟食紅肉拼盤
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Shiraz | Alcohol: 14.6% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: Prime steak, refined cured red meat platters

desc.zh:
香氣甜美成熟且芳香，帶有黑莓、煙燻與花香，並伴隨一絲黑巧克力氣息，口感豐富多汁、緊實飽滿，輔以絲滑質地與優雅單寧，餘韻悠長、風味十足。帶有鮮明沙士、覆盆子、新鮮土壤以及黑焦糖／太妃糖香氣，中等酒體，展現覆盆子、黑莓與黑櫻桃風味，甜美、酸爽與鹹香果味間完美平衡，迷迭香、百里香與草本氣息增添複雜度。
✿WineOrbit 94分✿
desc.en:
Sweet, ripe and aromatic, with blackberry, smoke and florals alongside a hint of dark chocolate. Rich, juicy and tightly packed, with a silky texture and elegant tannins, long and full of flavour. Distinctive sarsaparilla, raspberry, fresh earth and dark caramel/toffee; medium-bodied, showing raspberry, blackberry and black cherry in a fine balance of sweetness, freshness and savoury fruit, with rosemary, thyme and herbal notes adding complexity.
✿WineOrbit 94✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷｜葡萄品種：56% Grenache, 40% Shiraz, 4% Mataro｜酒精濃度：14%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：迷迭香烤羊排、義式香料燉肉、烤紅肉料理
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: 56% Grenache, 40% Shiraz, 4% Mataro | Alcohol: 14% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: Rosemary roasted lamb, Italian ragù, grilled red meats

desc.zh:
極其複雜且引人入勝的香氣，呈現出深色漿果、月桂葉、醃肉和烤杏仁的香氣，帶來極其柔順的口感，既廣闊又持久。酒體有精緻的質感與細膩的單寧結構支撐，散發甜菜根與土耳其軟糖的迷人香氣，並伴隨黑胡椒香料氣息，餘味悠長結構分明。
✿Halliday 94分、WineOrbit 95+分、Decanter Panel Tasting 94分、The Real Review四星推薦✿
desc.en:
Extremely complex and captivating — dark berries, bay leaf, charcuterie and roasted almond — leading to an exceptionally supple palate that is both expansive and long. Fine texture and a delicate tannin structure, with beetroot, Turkish delight and black pepper, and a long, well-defined finish.
✿Halliday 94, WineOrbit 95+, Decanter Panel Tasting 94, The Real Review 4 stars✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷｜葡萄品種：Grenache｜酒精濃度：14%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：法式烤鴨胸、冷肉拼盤、輕油脂肉類料理
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Grenache | Alcohol: 14% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: Pan-roasted duck breast, cold cuts, light-fat meats

desc.zh:
中度深紅色，散發出熟透的黑莓和黑巧克力香氣，伴隨著柑橘皮的氣息。口感豐富，帶有充沛的黑莓和黑巧克力風味，完美融合蛋糕香料、絲滑的黑巧克力、淡淡的雪松味和乾燥花香，單寧柔順細膩，尾韻充滿巧克力與礦物氣息，餘味綿長。
✿Halliday 92分、Decanter 95分、WineOrbit 93+分、Winepilot 94分優秀推薦✿
desc.en:
Medium-deep red, with ripe blackberry and dark chocolate alongside citrus peel. Rich on the palate with abundant blackberry and dark chocolate, seamlessly blended with cake spice, silky chocolate, a touch of cedar and dried florals. Supple, fine tannins and a long finish full of chocolate and minerality.
✿Halliday 92, Decanter 95, WineOrbit 93+, Winepilot 94✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷｜葡萄品種：Shiraz｜酒精濃度：14.4%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜適合搭配：美式 BBQ 燒烤、美式牛豬肋排、香料燉牛肉
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Shiraz | Alcohol: 14.4% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Food Pairing: American BBQ, grilled ribs, spiced beef stew

desc.zh:
開瓶後散發白花和乾燥香草的香氣，並帶有一絲鼠尾草的味道，酒體清新脆口，質感豐富，風味強勁且動感十足，餘味悠長。呈現淺稻草色，香氣有清新檸檬、酸爽葡萄柚和甜美水煮梨，並伴隨凝脂奶油、杏仁、碎石與精緻白色花香，手工採摘後於風乾法國橡木桶中陳釀5個月。
✿2024 Barossa Wine Show冠軍獎盃、2024 Halliday 92分、Winepilot 92分推薦✿
desc.en:
Opens with white flowers and dried herbs and a hint of sage. Fresh and crisp, richly textured and powerfully driven, with a long finish. Pale straw in the glass, with fresh lemon, tangy grapefruit and sweet poached pear, plus clotted cream, almond, crushed stone and delicate white blossom. Hand-picked and aged 5 months in air-dried French oak.
✿2024 Barossa Wine Show trophy, 2024 Halliday 92, Winepilot 92✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷｜葡萄品種：Grenache Blanc｜酒精濃度：13.1%｜最佳品飲溫度：14-16度｜適合搭配：佐奶油醬汁的海鮮、白肉料理、風乾火腿與堅果拼盤
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Grenache Blanc | Alcohol: 13.1% | Serving Temp: 14-16°C | Food Pairing: Creamy sauce seafood, white meat dishes, cured ham and nut platters

desc.zh:
手工採摘自 Moppa、Vine Vale 和 Bethany 的馬塔羅葡萄。酒體呈現紫紅色，散發藍莓、桑椹的香氣，帶有異國香料、土壤、烤肉，以及恰到好處的“馬塔羅灌木香”。酒體呈深紅寶石色，帶有濃郁的黑莓香氣，與煙燻/醃製的肉類和一點烘焙香料相映成趣。口感中展現了果味與鹹味的微妙平衡，融入了黑莓果醬、藍莓，並伴隨著橄欖醬、培根油脂和更多的熟肉香氣，帶有一絲鹹味。總體來說，這是一款果味純粹、異國風情的葡萄酒，帶有美妙的柔順單寧，飲用起來輕鬆愉快，風味濃郁但不厚重。
✿Halliday 95分, WineOrbit 93+分✿
desc.en:
Hand-harvested Mataro grapes sourced from Moppa, Vine Vale, and Bethany. Displaying a vibrant purple-red hue, it bursts with blueberry and mulberry aromas alongside exotic spices, earthy soil, roasted meat, and signature Mataro bush scents. The deep ruby body combines rich blackberry nuances with smoky cured meats and baking spices. The palate achieves a subtle balance between fruitiness and savory notes, introducing blackberry jam, blueberry, tapenade, bacon fat, and charcuterie tones with a savory edge. Overall, a pure, exotic, and medium-bodied wine with silky tannins that makes for an approachable yet intensely flavorful experience.
✿Halliday 95 Pts, WineOrbit 93+ Pts✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷 (Barossa Valley)｜葡萄品種：Mataro (馬塔羅)｜酒精濃度：14.2%｜最佳品飲溫度：16-18度｜評分：Halliday 95分, WineOrbit 93+分｜適合搭配：燒烤肉類、香料烤肉、煙燻與醃製肉類、熟肉與起司拼盤
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Mataro | Alcohol: 14.2% | Serving Temp: 16-18°C | Accolades: Halliday 95 Pts, WineOrbit 93+ Pts | Food Pairing: Grilled meats, barbecued dishes, smoked and cured meats, charcuterie and cheese platters

desc.zh:
酒杯中呈現淺稻草色，散發出青蘋果、燉梨和多汁柑橘的香氣，伴隨奶油、碎石、杏仁和白花氣息，口感絲滑愉悅，結尾乾淨，明亮酸度帶來充足速度感與活力。帶有奶酪元素與青蘋果、梨的香氣，口感有豐富酸度，柔和且易於接近，並有一點蜂蜜和鹹味提示，收尾乾爽。
✿2024 Halliday 92分、Winepilot 92分推薦✿
desc.en:
Pale straw in the glass, with green apple, stewed pear and juicy citrus alongside cream, crushed stone, almond and white blossom. Silky and pleasurable on the palate with a clean finish; bright acidity gives it pace and energy. Creamy notes with green apple and pear, generous acidity, soft and approachable, with a hint of honey and salinity and a dry finish.
✿2024 Halliday 92, Winepilot 92✿

taste.zh: 產區：巴羅莎谷｜葡萄品種：Chenin Blanc｜酒精濃度：13%｜最佳品飲溫度：14-16度｜適合搭配：生鮮生蠔蝦蟹、布里軟起司、輕食蔬果沙拉
taste.en: Region: Barossa Valley | Grape: Chenin Blanc | Alcohol: 13% | Serving Temp: 14-16°C | Food Pairing: Fresh oysters and seafood, Brie cheese, light green salads

intro.zh: 摩澤爾是德國最負盛名的白酒產區。葡萄園沿著蜿蜒的摩澤爾河，種植在近乎垂直的陡峭板岩坡地上。板岩白天吸收熱能、夜間釋放，為麗絲玲帶來獨特的礦物感與酸度骨架。酒款從不甜到微甜皆有，酒精濃度通常偏低，是全世界最優雅的麗絲玲產地之一。
intro.en: Mosel is Germany's most celebrated white-wine region. Its vineyards climb near-vertical slate slopes above the winding river, where the stone takes up heat by day and releases it at night — giving Riesling its unmistakable minerality and backbone of acidity. Styles run from bone-dry to gently sweet, usually at low alcohol: some of the most elegant Riesling made anywhere.

intro.zh: 波爾多位於法國西南部、吉倫特河口兩岸，是全球最知名的葡萄酒產區之一。以卡本內蘇維濃與梅洛等品種調配的紅酒聞名，也生產以白蘇維濃、賽美濃為主的干白酒。黏土、礫石與石灰岩比例不同，讓每一片地塊都有自己的個性。
intro.en: Bordeaux lies in south-west France on the banks of the Gironde estuary, and is among the best-known wine regions in the world. Famous for red blends of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, it also makes dry whites from Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon. Clay, gravel and limestone in different proportions give each plot its own character.

intro.zh: 巴羅莎谷位於南澳，是澳洲最具代表性的產區之一，以濃郁厚實的希哈聞名。溫暖乾燥的氣候讓果實充分成熟，酒款展現黑莓、黑巧克力與香料氣息。區內保有世界上最古老的希哈與格那希老藤，部分種植於 1840 年代。
intro.en: The Barossa Valley in South Australia is one of the country's defining regions, known for rich, full-bodied Shiraz. A warm, dry climate ripens the fruit fully, giving wines of blackberry, dark chocolate and spice. The valley also holds some of the oldest Shiraz and Grenache vines in the world, some planted in the 1840s.

story.zh: 六代傳承的波爾多靈魂。酒莊歷史可追溯至 18 世紀，自 1885 年由家族接管以來，歷經六代職人守候。位於聖馬凱爾的朝南山坡，擁有黏土石灰質土壤與百年古松的守護。秉持環境至上的低干預釀造，呈現天然果香與細膩單寧，被英國酒評家 Jancis Robinson 譽為波爾多性價比最高的酒莊之一。
story.en: A 140-Year Bordeaux Legacy. Tracing back to the 18th century and under family stewardship since 1885, Château Le Pin D'ambert spans six generations of winemaking craftsmanship. Located on the south-facing clay-limestone slopes of Saint-Martial and witnessed by a century-old pine tree, the estate practices minimal intervention to preserve pure natural flavors. Praised by renowned critic Jancis Robinson as one of Bordeaux's best-value wineries.

story.zh: 兄弟情誼與風土的結晶。由兩位充滿熱情的兄弟共同創立，將對土地的熱愛與釀酒工藝完美結合。酒莊專注於尊重自然、手工採摘與細緻的釀造過程，每一瓶酒都訴說著兄弟二人的夢想與對這片葡萄園的無盡承諾。
story.en: The Essence of Brotherhood and Terroir. Founded by two passionate brothers, Les 2 Frérots unites a profound love for the land with dedicated craftsmanship. Focusing on natural respect, manual harvesting, and meticulous vinification, every bottle reflects their shared dream and unwavering commitment to the vineyard.

story.zh: 始於 15 世紀的優雅印記，酒莊名稱源自坡地間一眼永不乾涸的泉源。自 1994 年起由 Luddecke 家族接管並悉心翻修，園內更有一棵見證自法國大革命至今、超過 200 年的日本槐樹。酒莊坐落於加龍河谷百米坡地，擁有黏土石灰質土壤與永續環保理念，現由接班人 Julius 守護，將大地的純淨滋味完美封存於瓶中。
story.en: A Timeless Legacy Since the 15th Century. Named after the eternal spring at the heart of the vineyard. Since 1994, the Luddecke family has meticulously restored the estate, which features a 200-year-old Japanese pagoda tree witnessing history since the French Revolution. Perched 100m above the Garonne Valley with clay-limestone soil and sustainable practices, successor Julius preserves this vibrant land, capturing the purest essence of nature in every bottle.

story.zh: 施瓦茨酒莊位於南澳巴羅莎谷，由釀酒師 Jason Schwarz 創立，專注以手工、小批次的方式釀造能表現地塊個性的酒款。巴羅莎的獨立風土之聲。座落於澳洲知名產區，專注於發掘古老葡萄園的獨特潛力。透過極少的人為干預與傳統釀造技法，完美捕捉產區的大膽個性與細緻層次，展現出澳洲葡萄酒最真實、純粹的風土樣貌。
story.en: Schwarz Wine Co. is a Barossa Valley producer founded by winemaker Jason Schwarz, working in small batches by hand to express the character of each site. The Voice of Independent Barossa Terroir. Situated in Australia's renowned wine region, Schwarz Wine Co. is dedicated to unlocking the unique potential of ancient vineyards. Through minimal intervention and traditional winemaking techniques, they capture the bold character and refined layers, revealing the purest expression of Australian terroir.

story.zh:
德國最老葡萄村的新生。由來自漢堡的「非傳統」跨界釀酒師共同創立，勇敢離開都市、落腳德國最古老的葡萄酒村 Neumagen-Dhron。他們專注於陡峭斜坡（Steillage）上的麗絲玲（Riesling），以無畏的熱情、對自然的敬畏與獨特手作風格，打破傳統框架，釀造出充滿純淨礦物感與個性的摩澤爾佳釀。
以雷司令為核心，輔以白皮諾與米勒-圖高，守護兩公頃的珍稀地塊。
德羅納·霍夫山坡的三色板岩賦予強烈礦質感；諾伊馬根玫瑰園則綻放細膩花果香。
在陡峭坡地上堅持全手工耕作，以永續精神成就高品質佳釀
story.en:
A new chapter for Germany's oldest wine village.
Unconventional Passion on the Mosel Slopes. Founded by "outsiders" who left their lives behind in Hamburg to settle in Germany's oldest wine village, Neumagen-Dhron. Focusing on steep-slope (Steillage) Riesling, they break conventions with fearlessness and respect for nature, crafting Mosel wines of pure mineral tension and distinct character.
Riesling is the core, supported by Pinot Blanc and Müller-Thurgau, across two hectares of rare parcels.
The three-colour slate of the Dhroner Hofberg gives intense minerality; the Neumagener Rosengärten blooms with delicate floral and fruit notes.
Everything on these steep slopes is worked by hand, in a spirit of sustainability.
